title: Instagram Sales on Autopilot: Your Own AI Sales Rep Working 24/7
body:
How many sales have you lost because you took more than 30 minutes to reply to an Instagram DM?

The reality of modern commerce is harsh: the client who types 'Price' or 'More info' in your Direct Messages (DMs) is hot and ready to buy right now. If you're sleeping, in a meeting, or simply overwhelmed from answering the same question to 100 people, that client goes to your competition, and all your marketing effort is wasted.

The Trap of Canned Responses

To avoid losing hours on their phone, many entrepreneurs fall into the mistake of using basic option-based chatbots (like 'Press 1 for shipping'). The result? The client feels like they're talking to a 90s answering machine, gets frustrated, and leaves the chat. Nobody wants to talk to a dumb robot.

Our Solution: A Cognitive Agent Connected to Your Business

At LANZAESTUDIO.ES we don't set up rigid button flows. We connect the Official Instagram API directly with an advanced Artificial Intelligence model. We feed it your product catalog, your shipping policies, and your prices. From that moment on, you have a virtual sales rep:

  1. Natural Conversation: The AI understands context, answers complex doubts, and speaks with your brand's exact tone. The client doesn't notice the difference.
  2. Filtering Looky-Loos: The Agent asks key questions to find out if the client genuinely intends to buy or is just browsing.
  3. Closing and Payment Links: When the client is convinced, the AI generates a payment link (Stripe, PayPal) instantly.
  4. Human Handoff: If it detects a highly complex issue, it alerts your team so you can step in, giving you the full context of the conversation.

The Real Impact on Your Sales

  • Immediate 24/7 Attention: You close sales at 3 AM on a Sunday.
  • Infinite Scalability: It doesn't matter if you get 10 or 1,000 messages a day; the system handles all of them simultaneously without crashing.
  • Get Your Time Back: You get your life back outside of your phone screen, knowing your business is still generating revenue.
